verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair axis for an ecommerce platform, but the evidence shows BigCommerce only as a hosted SaaS platform. Stencil is described as building 'hosted storefronts', and Catalyst and the headless APIs only let you run your own front end against BigCommerce's hosted backend. Running a theme locally for development is not self-hosting the core product, so nothing in the pack shows the core can be deployed on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
